name: opum-quest
description: Drive the quest CLI: create, list, view, edit, complete, and archive tasks, drafts, milestones, and decisions in a Quest-initialized workspace instead of editing tracker state directly. Cut from the same quest-cli repository and tag as the CLI itself, so this skill can never describe a version you don't have. Also ships the Quest board: a pane listing the tasks being worked on across the operator's Quest workspaces, editable in the session's own repository.

actor.title: Quest actor id
actor.description: Who edits made in the pane are recorded as (--actor, kind human)

root.title: Fleet root
root.description: The directory holding your Quest workspaces. Unset, discovery walks up from the session's own directory.

repos.title: Repositories
repos.description: Comma-separated repository names to put on the board, when you would rather name them than discover them. Empty discovers them.
